benchmark.basis: One existing 512x512 split SCENE buffer and 138 ROI IDs; reference builds one sparse shared contrast boundary then scans N target masks.
benchmark.scope: One existing first split 512x512 SCENE buffer. Each implementation forms one sparse contrast boundary. The reference scans 138 target masks; optimized uses two histograms. Whole observation performance, former six-ROI timing, statistical significance and AI task benefit are outside this comparison.
benchmark.tail_definition: maximum of five calls in each arm

bytes.scope: Wire, base64, text, compressed files and raw arrays are distinct layers. PNG content equality across representations does not cancel two actual generation or publication costs. Mapping arrays are repeated in each NPZ while one prepared image adapter shares its in-process mapping; published payload is not resident peak memory. RSS, allocator overhead and process peak are unmeasured.

integration.stage_accounting: Nested prepare/index, service/lookup, render/publish and feedback subclocks are listed separately and are not added as independent wall costs. Hot generation_work/stages repeat historical cold evidence; only current work and current stages are counted.
